Team —

- Freespan — GREEN, legal updated draft, expected signature next week.
- Ivory Health — RED, exec engagement stalled; recommend playbook insert and AE backup.

1) Owners: please update "commit_status" and probable close date in the sheet by 5pm PT.
2) Marissa: run a commit-review call for any yellow→red transitions; capture blockers.
3) Dylan: queue a CS readiness check for ACME if Jordan confirms procurement next week.
4) Karthik: produce a 1-paragraph risk summary for any red deals for finance forecast.

I'm looping in Rishi for a quick FYI to finance — if any of these escalate we'll want to move them into the save plan roster. Attaching the mutual action plan template for ACME (acme_mutual_action_plan.pdf).

Thanks —
